summary: Payouts Hub consolidation (advisor 15% / merchant 5%, Earnings dashboard, Onboarding gate, retirement of vendor_payments) tested end-to-end on backend + web + mobile. All 9 executed backend tests passed (2 skipped only because a Stripe account is created during the onboard test — the 'agreement_required' + 'no_account' branches only fire on a truly fresh account, which they did on this run before creation). Web /payouts and /admin/platform-fees, and mobile /payouts (reached both directly and via Profile -> menu-payouts), all render correctly and expose the required testIDs. Vendor_payments retirement verified (both endpoints 404). Advisor booking checkout gate returns 409 advisor_payout_not_ready when require_onboarding=true and the advisor is not payout-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: payouts_hub.py hard-codes a preview host as fallback for _frontend_url (line 58). Non-critical because _origin() prefers the request's Origin/Referer header, but the fallback should ideally come from an env var only.

PayoutsOnboarding.jsx uses window.alert on error and only surfaces the raw detail code (line 124). Fine for MVP but user-hostile — swap for a toast with the mapped copy for known codes (agreement_required, no_account, advisor_payout_not_ready).

In test runs the merchant Stripe account persists across iterations (demo@ now has stripe_account_id from this session's onboard test). Not a bug but the agreement_required/no_account paths will keep skipping in future regression runs unless the test resets the field first.
seed_data_creation: None. Test onboarded demo@'s merchant business (The Grind Coffee (Demo)) through /api/payouts/onboard which created a real Stripe TEST connected account (charges_enabled=false, needs KYC).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The demo merchant (biz for The Grind Coffee (Demo)) now HAS a stripe_account_id but is NOT active — /payouts shows PENDING with 'Finish Stripe setup' (testID payout-resume-merchant) instead of the agreement checkbox + connect button. To exercise the fresh-onboarding UI (payout-agree-merchant + payout-connect-merchant), unset businesses.stripe_account_id/stripe_charges_enabled for the demo merchant first. Same applies to the backend 'agreement_required' + 'no_account' branches. Admin fees at /admin/platform-fees confirmed persisting advisor=15/merchant=5/gate=true.
